beats: A call rings silent, or a notification never shows — it looks like the app is broken.
Often it isn't broken. Android itself quietly denied the camera, microphone or full-screen call permission.
There was no single place to see which permission was missing, or what build was even running.
Now a settings screen lists every permission and the build hash, with a tap straight to the fix.
Troubleshooting a device, instead of guessing over text, now comes down to one screen.
